name: Beraja
title: Benjaminitic patriarch
summary: Beraja was a son of Shimei and belonged to the tribe of Benjamin. He is mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles as one of the prominent family heads among the Benjamites who lived in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Benjamin's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Beraja is listed as one of the sons of Shimei in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: The Family Heads in Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Beraja belonged to the family heads among the Benjamites who were recorded in the genealogical lists, attesting to his position within the tribe.

keyEvents.title: Benjamites in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: The genealogies in 1 Chronicles show how the Benjamites, including Beraja's family, were connected to settlement in Jerusalem and the surrounding area.

keyEvents.title: The Significance of the Lineage After the Exile
keyEvents.description: The genealogical records of the tribe of Benjamin were preserved and written down in the Books of Chronicles, highlighting the tribe's continued importance in Israel's history after returning from exile.
